title: Allowing bursts
hints: Model the allowance as a buffered channel of tokens with capacity burst. Wait takes a token: <-l.tokens. Fill the buffer completely in NewLimiter so the first burst calls don't wait.
A goroutine adds one token per tick, but only if there's room: a select with a default case, so a full bucket simply drops the token. It exits when stop is closed.
go func() { t := time.NewTicker(every); defer t.Stop(); for { select { case <-t.C: select { case l.tokens <- struct{}{}: default: }; case <-l.stop: return } } }()
